action_identity.business_purpose: Turn bounded public observation into a proof-bound paid readiness-review package without contacting customers.

buyer_visible_summary.short_plain_english_explanation: This Black Box shows what an agent intended to do, what evidence it used, what boundaries governed it, what it actually produced, and what cannot yet be claimed.
what_a_buyer_can_trust: the action did not contact anyone
the package used bounded public evidence
what_a_buyer_still_cannot_trust: that the offer is market validated
that the static packet is enterprise-ready
buyer_visible_summary.why_this_is_not_fake_evidence: Every buyer-facing claim is tied to a public receipt or marked as internal inference/hypothesis; unsupported claims are removed.
